_doc: Per-city Instagram hashtag/location sources for the net-new handle-discovery sweep. The hashtag-location-discovery scheduled task opens these Explore pages (https://www.instagram.com/explore/tags/<tag>/), harvests post-OWNER handles (visible in the DOM, unlike the Graph API), semantically vets them (dog event/venue/organizer, correct city, not an individual pet account), and inserts the net-new ones into watch_handles via agents/add-watch-handles.mjs. The existing free server-side handle-discovery cron then mines them forever — the compounding loop. Tags are stored WITHOUT the leading #. Add location URLs under 'locations' as full Explore location URLs when known.
